name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
